title: BEAUTIFUL WHITE
text:
BEAUTIFUL WHITE. l love it for the price!
Update….. I bought another one just recently and the QUALITY IS HORRIBLE!
They changed the quality and raised the price. BACK IT GOES! I refuse to buy into this GARBAGE. Don’t waste your money. They make a batch of this low quality stuff and think they can sell the daylights out of it. Not me! Not this time. RETURNED. It’s JUNK! And it came from the same seller. SHAME ON YOU

product_metadata.title: Ashler faux fur rug, Fluffy Shaggy Area Rug Ultra Soft 2 x 6 Feet Sheepskin Fur Rug, Frosted Bottom Pink Fuzzy Rug Machine Washable Shag Rug, Nursery Decor Throw Rugs for Bedroom, Living Room
features: 【 Upgrade Material Fur Rug 】Made of premium Mongolian faux fur, featuring our faux sheepskin rug to super soft and fluffy feeling. Durable high-density material with great stitching makes it not easy to shed.
【 Non-slip Backing 】 Slip-resistant suede leather is used for the bottom side with superb sewing, which ensures the firmness and durability of the rug, preventing shifting and skidding effectively.

【 Superior Dyeing Process 】Our luxury and cozy area rug is manufactured by a special dyeing process, the tip part of the rug is an elegant white. Two-tone design and gradient effect bring ultimate visual experience.

【 Perfect Size 】Ashler faux sheepskin fur rug in various sizes, wonderful size for home decor. Widely used in the living room, kid's playroom, bedroom, nursery, balcony to cover the hardwoods, bedside, or leisure areas.
【 Easy Clean and Care 】As a portable rug, shake it to fluff up the faux fur when taking out the item. Easy to vacuum it or wipe with a damp cloth, flat to dry.
